tasks.label: Build
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -ErrorAction Stop build | Out-Null; gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude -c src/glad.c -o build/glad.o; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -DGLFW_DLL -Iinclude src/main.cpp build/glad.o -Llib -lglfw3dll -lopengl32 -o build/OpenGLRenderer.exe; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item -Path glfw3.dll -Destination build/glfw3.dll -Force -ErrorAction Stop
